title: Finite continuous coefficient sheaves are constant
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, A its valuation ring and varpi the recorded uniformizer. Let X be any scheme. Use the continuous coefficient sheaves, scalar maps, normalized towers and quotient predicate of [def-per-integral-lisse-reduction-data]. For every positive level n+1, the constant sheaf of A/(varpi^(n+1)) on the small pro-etale site is canonically isomorphic to its continuous-function sheaf. The isomorphism sends every sheafified constant section a to the continuous constant function a.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1),(2), Definition 6.8.3, Proposition 6.8.4(1), p. 59; the reduction ring identification is the rank-one reduction in this proposition.

proof.text:
the normalized profinite tower identifies each finite quotient with a discrete
space: its projection to a discrete coordinate is continuous and the quotient map
has the final topology. Map the constant presheaf into continuous functions by
constant functions. A continuous function to a discrete finite ring is constant on
its open fibres. Restricting the scheme to these open subsets gives a Zariski,
hence pro-etale, cover on which it is in the image. If two constant sections have
the same function on an object, they are equal whenever the object has a point.
When it is empty, the empty covering gives local equality. Thus this presheaf map
is locally bijective. The universal sheafification map and the local-bijection
criterion give an isomorphism from the constant ring sheaf. Its value on each
sheafified constant section is the original constant function by the defining
factorization. This also proves uniqueness and handles the empty base. The open cover is indexed by points of the source scheme rather than residue values, so its index is in the scheme universe. The local-injectivity proof uses the empty cover when distinct constants agree.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Proposition 6.8.4(1), coefficient and local-basis arguments

lean.statement:
theorem integralLisseFiniteConstant_exists (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (CommRingCat.of (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))) ≅
        integralLisseFiniteRing l E X n,
      ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)),
      ((e.hom.hom.app U)
        ((toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
            (CommRingCat.of (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))).app U a)) =
        integralLisseFiniteConstant l E X n U a
